feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—I've definitely seen agents get stuck in infinite loops, so that hit home. I like that you didn't use 'smart drawers' or any of that cringe AI-influencer slang. My only issue is 'meta-reflection call' in Beat 4; it sounds like a fancy way of saying 're-prompting,' but I'm not sure if it's an actual function call or just a conceptual step. If it's a specific architectural pattern, you should name-drop the library or the logic behind it.
